name: TIE/ph "Phantom" Multi-Role Stealth Starfighter
description: The TIE/ph "Phantom" Multi-Role Stealth Starfighter, also referred to as the TIE/ph phantom, TIE Phantom or Phantom V38, was a prototype TIE Series starfighter developed by the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. A modified V38 assault fighter, the TIE phantom was the result of a development project led by Grand Admiral Martio Batch and was equipped with both deflector shields and a hyperdrive, along with a technology not seen for decades—a stygium cloaking device.
